scripts.cf:prep: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('cf-public',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('cf-public');for(const f of ['index.html'])fs.copyFileSync(f,'cf-public/'+f);for(const f of ['og-image.png','oembed.json'])fs.copyFileSync(f,'cf-public/'+f);fs.copyFileSync('server/voice-lines.json','cf-public/voice-lines.json');fs.cpSync('voices','cf-public/voices',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('music','cf-public/music',{recursive:true,filter:f=>!f.endsWith('_names.txt')});for(const d of ['levels','arenas'])if(fs.existsSync(d))fs.cpSync(d,'cf-public/'+d,{recursive:true})"
scripts.cf:dev: npm run cf:prep && wrangler dev -c cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run cf:prep && wrangler deploy -c cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run cf:prep && wrangler pages deploy cf-public --project-name sky-jump --branch main
